module Main (main) where

import Data.List (intercalate)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS

main :: IO ()
main = do
  mline <- BS.getLine
  case mline of
    Nothing -> return ()
    Just line -> do
      let s = BS.dropWhile (`elem` " \t") line
      if BS.null s
        then return ()
        else do
          let n0 = maybe 0 id (fst <$> BS.readInteger s)
              n = max 0 n0
          let go i acc
                | i > n = []
                | i == 0 = 0 : go 1 0
                | otherwise =
                    let v = acc !! fromIntegral (i - fromIntegral (length acc) + fromIntegral (length acc))
                    in v : go (i + 1) v
          -- simple DP without popcount
          let arr = 0 : [ (arr !! fromIntegral (i `div` 2)) + fromIntegral (i `mod` 2)
                         | i <- [1 .. n] ]
          putStrLn (unwords (map show (take (fromIntegral n + 1) arr)))
